versions.commitMessage: Round 2 schema; sending opt-in and capped

definition.name: RF-04 Customer Liaison
definition.description: Tells the people who raised tickets that the agent resolved them. Rebuilt for Round 2: selects on what RF-03 actually writes, uses a visible built-in message template, and sending is opt-in and capped.

inputs.name: test_recipient_email
inputs.description: Every message goes here, never to the real reporter.
inputs.label: Test recipient email

inputs.name: send
inputs.description: yes actually sends mail. no performs a dry run.
inputs.label: Send email (yes/no)

inputs.name: max_emails
inputs.description: Never send more than this many in one run.
inputs.label: Maximum emails

steps.name: Fetch Resolved Issues
steps.description: Fetch auto-resolved tickets from Supabase that haven't been notified yet.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _key(url, token): """A service_role JWT is already the key. The Round 1 build always went to the Management API first, which is what broke every fetch step.""" if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token ref = url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as c: r = await c.get(f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}) r.raise_for_status() for k in r.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _ctx(): url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_URL") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") if not url or not token: raise ValueError("Supabase URL or SUPABASE_TOKEN missing.") return url, token def _get(row, *names): for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None async def run(): url, token = _ctx() key = await _key(url, token) headers = {"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"} # Round 1 filtered on "Status" and on a customer_notified column. Neither # exists here: the column is lowercase "status", and customer_notified was # never part of the Round 2 schema. Selecting on what RF-03 actually writes # is both correct and honest - these are tickets this agent resolved. async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as c: r = await c.get(f"{url}/rest/v1/issues", params={"select": "*", "status": "eq.Resolved", "resolved_by": "eq.auto", "limit": "200"}, headers=headers) if r.status_code not in (200, 206): raise Exception(f"issues: HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}") rows = r.json() state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) state["fetch_issues"] = rows print(json.dumps({"auto_resolved_awaiting_notice": len(rows), "tickets": [_get(x, "issue_key") for x in rows]}, indent=2)) body = "" for x in rows[:12]: body += ("" + str(_get(x, "issue_key")) + "" + str(_get(x, "summary"))[:60] + "" + str(_get(x, "reporter")) + "") display(HTML("""

Tickets the agent resolved

""" + str(len(rows)) + """ ticket(s) carry status Resolved and resolved_by=auto - written by RF-03 after the policy gate allowed it. These are the people who should be told.

""" + body + """
TicketSummary Reporter
""")) await run()

steps.name: Fetch Users Directory
steps.description: Fetch the user directory to map reporter names to email addresses.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _key(url, token): """A service_role JWT is already the key. The Round 1 build always went to the Management API first, which is what broke every fetch step.""" if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token ref = url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as c: r = await c.get(f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}) r.raise_for_status() for k in r.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _ctx(): url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_URL") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") if not url or not token: raise ValueError("Supabase URL or SUPABASE_TOKEN missing.") return url, token def _get(row, *names): for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None async def run(): url, token = _ctx() key = await _key(url, token) async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as c: r = await c.get(f"{url}/rest/v1/users_directory", params={"select": "*", "limit": "1000"}, headers={"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}) if r.status_code not in (200, 206): raise Exception(f"users_directory: HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}") users = r.json() state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) state["fetch_users"] = users print(json.dumps({"users": len(users)}, indent=2)) display(HTML("""

steps.name: Fetch Configuration
steps.description: Fetch the email template from the configuration table.
steps.code_cell:
import json from IPython.display import HTML, display # Round 1 read the message template from a config table. Round 2 has no such # table, so the template lives here where anyone can read it. A message sent to # a customer should never be assembled from something nobody can see. TEMPLATE = ( "Hello {name},\n\n" "Your ticket {issue_key} has been resolved.\n\n" "What was done: {resolution}\n\n" "This was carried out automatically after an automated policy check " "confirmed the fix was reversible and cleared for automatic use. " "If the problem is still happening, reply to this message and it will " "be reopened for a person to look at.\n\n" "Service Desk" ) state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) state["fetch_config"] = {"template": TEMPLATE, "source": "built-in"} print(json.dumps({"template_source": "built-in", "length": len(TEMPLATE)}, indent=2)) display(HTML("""

Message template

No configuration table exists in Round 2, so this built-in template is used. It is shown in full rather than hidden in code.

""" + TEMPLATE + """
"""))

steps.name: Process Tickets and Send Notifications
steps.description: Match reporters for personalization, compose the notification using the template, send it to the testing email address via Outlook, and update the ticket in Supabase.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _key(url, token): """A service_role JWT is already the key. The Round 1 build always went to the Management API first, which is what broke every fetch step.""" if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token ref = url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as c: r = await c.get(f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}) r.raise_for_status() for k in r.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _ctx(): url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_URL") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") if not url or not token: raise ValueError("Supabase URL or SUPABASE_TOKEN missing.") return url, token def _get(row, *names): for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None async def _send(subject, body_text, to_addr): token = os.environ.get("MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_TOKEN") if not token or not to_addr: return {"sent": False, "detail": "Outlook connector or recipient missing."} payload = {"message": { "subject": subject, "body": {"contentType": "HTML", "content": "
" + body_text.replace(chr(10), "
") + "
"}, "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address": to_addr}}]}, "saveToSentItems": True} try: async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as c: r = await c.post("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/sendMail", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}, json=payload) return {"sent": r.status_code in (200, 202), "detail": f"Graph returned HTTP {r.status_code}"} except Exception as exc: return {"sent": False, "detail": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"} async def run(): state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) issues = state.get("fetch_issues", []) users = state.get("fetch_users", []) template = (state.get("fetch_config") or {}).get("template", "") to_addr = (user_inputs.get("test_recipient_email") or "").strip() # Sending is opt-in. A demo that mails real people every time it is # rehearsed is a demo nobody rehearses. send = str(user_inputs.get("send", "no")).strip().lower() in ("yes", "true", "1") try: cap = int(str(user_inputs.get("max_emails", "3")).strip()) except ValueError: cap = 3 by_name = {str(_get(u, "display_name") or "").strip().lower(): u for u in users} results = [] for issue in issues[:cap]: key = _get(issue, "issue_key") or "UNKNOWN" reporter = str(_get(issue, "reporter") or "").strip() user = by_name.get(reporter.lower()) if not user: results.append({"issue_key": key, "status": "skipped", "reason": "reporter not in the user directory"}) continue message = template.format( name=str(_get(user, "display_name") or reporter), issue_key=key, resolution=str(_get(issue, "resolution") or "Resolved")) subject = f"[{key}] Your ticket has been resolved" if not send: results.append({"issue_key": key, "status": "dry run", "would_email": to_addr, "real_reporter_address": _get(user, "email_address"), "subject": subject}) continue out = await _send(subject, message, to_addr) results.append({"issue_key": key, "status": "sent" if out["sent"] else "failed", "detail": out["detail"], "to": to_addr}) state["process_and_notify"] = results print(json.dumps({"mode": "send" if send else "dry run", "cap": cap, "results": results}, indent=2, default=str)) rows = "" for r in results: rows += ("" + str(r.get("issue_key")) + "" + str(r.get("status")) + "" + str(r.get("detail") or r.get("reason") or r.get("real_reporter_address") or "") + "") heading = "Notifications sent" if send else "Dry run - no mail was sent" display(HTML("""

""" + heading + """

Every message is redirected to the test address rather than to the real reporter, so a rehearsal never reaches a customer. The reporter's true address is shown for verification only.

""" + rows + """
TicketStatus Detail
""")) await run()
